title: fix(ui): a tree list view draws the view's authored empty state, and the tree's load failure is translated
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNy46ZS2ZhE1irAPWp5FY5P)_

Fixes #28966

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6572298995).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表视图以树形显示且没有记录时，现在和表格、画廊一样显示视图作者写的空状态（标题、说明、图标、链接），没写就显示本地化的"这里还没有数据"；树加载失败时显示翻译后的"无法加载记录"加上错误原文，不再是英文的 "Failed to load tree: …"。
- 为什么改：管理员给视图写的空状态说明，在表格和画廊上能看到，切到树形（例如 Setup › 业务单元默认就是树）就丢了，只剩通用的"暂无数据"；中文页面上树加载失败还冒出一句英文。
- 风险与回滚：只影响树形视图的空结果和加载失败两种情况；有记录的树、其他视图类型不变。没有新增元数据键或选项。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ListView.tsx` 空状态分支的条件（加了 `tree`）；`ObjectTree.tsx` 加载失败分支改为 `DataErrorState`；新测试 `ListView.treeEmptyState-28966.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.treeEmptyState-28966.test.tsx packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.loadErrorI18n-28966.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 8 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Empty tree views (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`).** The empty-state branch now covers `tree` as well as `grid` and `gallery`, so an empty tree list view draws `ListEmptyState`: the authored `emptyState` first, resolved against the display locale, otherwise the localized `list.*` copy, with the same Create, Clear search and Clear filters actions. Before, the empty set went to `ObjectTree`, which reads no `emptyState` and drew `common.noData`. The edit is the condition plus its comment; nothing else in the branch moved.
- **Which of the two routes, measured.** The card offered widening the `ListView` condition or handing the resolved empty state to `ObjectTree`. Widening was taken. `ObjectTree` has no toolbar of its own (its only chrome is the refresh bar over drawn rows), and the list toolbar sits outside the branch, so it stays on screen above the empty state; a test pins its Filter and Refresh buttons there. Handing the state down would have needed a new host prop on `ObjectTree`, against "no new option". `ListView` already fetches a tree view with the same effective filter the tree's own query is handed (`selfQueryFilter`) and with no search term (`searchlessViewOnScreen`), so its empty `data` is the tree's empty answer too.
- **Tree load failures (`ui/packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`).** The English literal "Failed to load tree: MESSAGE" is now a `DataErrorState` (`role="alert"`, `data-testid="tree-load-error"`) titled by `list.loadErrorTitle` ("Couldn't load records", the list failure panel's own title) with the error's message under it, the shape `ObjectGrid` gives its failure. The key is borrowed, not minted: no pack gains a key, so `@object-ui/i18n` is untouched and `Clause-②: no` holds. The key is added to the tree's provider-less defaults table, as `grid.refreshing` and `common.noData` already are.
- **Repointed pin.** `ObjectTree.inlineQueryKeys-9136.test.tsx` asserted the absence of the old English text, which would have passed vacuously after the change; it now asserts the absence of `tree-load-error`.

## Tests

- New `ListView.treeEmptyState-28966.test.tsx` (tree is a stand-in registered as `object-tree`; this package does not depend on `plugin-tree`, and the pinned decision is whether the tree is mounted at all):
  - CONTROL: with a row, the tree stand-in is mounted and no empty state;
  - an authored plain-string `emptyState` is drawn as written, in place of the tree;
  - an authored inline locale map paints its zh-CN entries;
  - zh with nothing authored: the pack's first-run copy, not `暂无数据`;
  - the wide toolbar's Filter and Refresh stay on screen above the empty tree;
  - the tree and the grid draw the same empty state, node for node.
- New `ObjectTree.loadErrorI18n-28966.test.tsx`: under the zh pack a rejected read shows an alert titled `无法加载记录` with the error message, and no English line; with no provider, the English title from the defaults table and the message.
- Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD's blob): with the condition put back to grid/gallery only, 5 of 6 cases in the new ListView file go red and the CONTROL stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- A standalone `object-tree` node (not under a list view) still draws `common.noData` when empty: the tree node declares no empty-text key, and the card asks for no new key. Unchanged by this PR.
